headline: Dengue: Yearly death toll crosses 200 as 6 more die
summary: September has become the deadliest month of the year, recording 104 fatalities so far, while nearly 1,900 new patients were hospitalized in 24 hours.
details: Bangladesh has reported six more dengue deaths in a 24-hour period, bringing the total number of fatalities this year to 201, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

headline_marked: 11 more die as [[measles outbreak toll reaches 1,076]] in Bangladesh
headline: 11 more die as measles outbreak toll reaches 1,076 in Bangladesh
summary: The DGHS reports 11 new suspected measles deaths in 24 hours, with total suspected cases nationwide now exceeding 183,000.
details: Eleven more patients died of measles-like symptoms in Bangladesh within a 24-hour period, bringing the total death toll to 1,076.
The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) has classified all 11 recent fatalities as suspected measles deaths.
According to DGHS data, total suspected measles deaths have reached 975, while laboratory-confirmed deaths stand at 101.
In the last 24 hours, 1,157 new suspected cases were reported, pushing the cumulative number of suspected infections nationwide to 183,449.
Additionally, 113 new confirmed measles cases were recorded, bringing the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 20,851.
Since March 15 this year, 162,048 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country, with 155,612 having recovered.
